scripts.build: rm -rf dist && esbuild src/content.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/content.js && cp -R manifest.json src/content.css icons dist/
scripts.package: node -e "const p=require('./package.json').version,m=require('./manifest.json').version;if(p!==m)throw new Error('version mismatch: package.json '+p+' vs manifest.json '+m)" && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && rm -f extension.zip && cd dist && zip -qrX ../extension.zip .
